data.narrative:
Mara is a pre-seed stage company in Defense & Security founded by Daniel Kofman and Sriram Raghu, having raised $1.6M to date. The Defense & Security sector comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Two standard valuation triangulation methods were assessed. Stage-Progression analysis was deemed inapplicable: the implied $750M valuation derived from a $300M base value and 2.5x step-up multiplier would exceed 20x total capital raised, flagging the base input as unreliable. Peer-Median comparison was similarly skipped due to insufficient narrow peer clustering—while 23 same-sector companies exist in the database, zero pre-seed stage peers and only one adjacent-stage peer met filter criteria, below the three-datapoint minimum needed to establish a defensible median. Broadening to all-sector medians risked introducing comparability distortion.

The analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation range at this time. The primary constraint is data sparsity: pre-seed companies in frontier defense tech remain rare in available databases. Establishing valuation requires either (1) proprietary diligence on the top five private peers' recent round economics, or (2) forward funnel analysis tied to realistic Series A outcomes for this stage and sector. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation within defense applications and founder track record validation relative to the cohort.
